description: Suggest matching ship, port, destination and cruise line names, including suffix words. Returns stable term IDs for search filters.

amenity.description: Exact captured amenity name from get_sailing ship.amenities[].name.

cabinClass.description: Normalized cabin class: inside, oceanview, balcony, suite, or other, as captured on the offer.

dateFlexDays.description: Optional departure flexibility, 0–30 days before dateFrom and after dateTo. Requires both dates when positive. Exact matches stay in items; outside-window options are separate dateAlternatives. All other filters remain strict. Use only when the user permits flexible dates.

departurePort.description: Departure port selection: shared port suggestion ID or source-native items[].departurePort.id. Reviewed equivalent ports match across cruise lines; source still restricts the line. Different embarkation ports remain distinct.

departureTerms.description: Port IDs from suggest_cruise_terms, matching departure only (OR within this list). General terms ports also match visited ports. Other filters still apply.

destination.description: Shared destination suggestion ID or destination label. Umbrella destinations such as Caribbean include mapped subregions across cruise lines. Specific regions remain strict; generic Caribbean does not imply Eastern Caribbean. Prefer suggest_cruise_terms to resolve names.

durationMax.description: Maximum normalized duration in days, not advertised nights.

durationMin.description: Minimum normalized duration in days, not advertised nights.

nightsMax.description: Maximum nights, inclusive. Prefer nightsMin/nightsMax for cruise trip lengths; legacy durationMin/durationMax are days-only.

nightsMin.description: Minimum nights. Uses advertised nights, otherwise calendar nights between captured departure and return dates. Unknown durations cannot match.

priceMaxCents.description: Maximum captured USD cents per person for two guests; 50000 means USD 500/person. Not a party total.

returnBy.description: Inclusive latest disembarkation date, YYYY-MM-DD; excludes unknown return dates. This deadline never expands with dateFlexDays.

ship.description: Source-native ship ID from items[].ship.id, not a suggestion term ID. Prefer terms for names.

source.description: Source ID: carnival, royal_caribbean, msc, norwegian, celebrity, princess, holland_america, costa, disney, virgin, aida, tui_cruises, p_and_o, cunard.

terms.description: Stable term IDs from suggest_cruise_terms; prefer these for entity-name filtering.

items.description: Complete suggestion item ID including ship:, port:, destination:, or line: prefix.

view.description: Default groups combines departures for each ship itinerary; sailings returns one row per unique dated sailing. Event-specific fares remain available within each sailing.

visitedPort.description: Visited port selection: shared port suggestion ID or source-native items[].visitedPorts[].id. Reviewed equivalent ports match across cruise lines; source still restricts the line.

name: suggest_cruise_terms
title: Find ships and destinations
